matches.preview: Oracle90's model strongly favours Arsenal, giving them an 81% probability of victory compared to 13% for a draw and 6% for a Coventry City win. Coventry City return to this level, with their six-match unbeaten run at the end of last season now part of their lower-tier history, while the two clubs have no recorded head-to-head fixtures. The model leans towards a higher-scoring outcome, rating the chance of over 2.5 total goals at 61%.

Manchester United concluded their previous top-flight campaign with five wins from their final six matches, including a 3-0 victory at Brighton. Hull City return to this level after ending last season in the second tier with a 2-1 win against Norwich. History points the same way, as Manchester United went unbeaten in their five meetings between 2014 and 2017.
